Name: ThinkingTime - Auto Pause When Idle
Author: PokeBenji
Description:
[b]ThinkingTime![/b] Time only moves when you do, just like in [b]SUPERHOT[/b]! Call it AFK protection, accessibility, cheating or whatever you like!
This mod ensures you never miss a beat in your Stardew Valley adventure, whether you're away from your keyboard or planning your next move.

[b][u]PC & MOBILE COMPATIBLE!!!![/u][/b]

Features[list]
[*][b]Time Control[/b]: Automatically pauses the game when you're idle, giving you complete control over time.
[*][b]HUD Indicator[/b]: A visual cue on the HUD lets you know when the game is paused.
[*][b]Fishing Flexibility[/b]: Includes an option to keep the game unpaused while casting a fishing rod, so you can enjoy uninterrupted fishing sessions.
[*][b]Customizable[/b]: Easily toggle the mod on or off and rebind the toggle key (default is Backspace) via the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).
[*][b]Safety First[/b]: Keeps you invincible while the game is paused to prevent any accidental damage.
[/list]
Installation[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu for easy in-game configuration.
[*]Download and unzip the mod files.
[*]Place the `ThinkingTime` folder into your Modsdirectory.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Configuration
[list]
[*]If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can configure the mod settings in-game. Otherwise, you can manually edit the config.json file generated after the first run of the mod.
[/list]
[b][u]Join the [url=https://discord.gg/NJJCmpW8uJ]Discord[/url]![/u][/b]

[b][u]CREDITS
[/u][/b]Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jorgamun/about-me?gameId=1303]jorgamun [/url]and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10328]Pause Time in Multiplayer[/url] Mod for getting the time stop to actually stop everything.
